recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-7158; any future Observation.specimen wording changes should be handled under later OO decisions or new work-group trackers.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO issue for DSTU1 asking to change the Observation.specimen comment from saying Observation resources "are often" used in specimen-tracking contexts such as Diagnostic Report to saying they "may be" used in those contexts.
initial_application: Historical commit ff6b620add (#7156,7158 edits to element descriptions and notes) changed source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml from "are often used in contexts" to "may be used in contexts" and added committee note 7158. The 2021 source rework preserved that trail in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml is in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-50127 replaced the older Observation.specimen comment with current SHOULD guidance and is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not republished here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were changed because the old wording is gone, FHIR-7158 was applied historically, and the current wording follows the later FHIR-50127 decision.

related_jiras.note: The same 2015 source commit also applied an Observation.subject donor clarification, but that is a separate element and was not needed to decide FHIR-7158.
